# Nova Agency

> Nova Agency's website presents communication, advertising, audiovisual production and talent-related services. This repository currently serves a static website demonstrator.

## Public website
- Website: https://nova-agency-nu.vercel.app/
- Services: https://nova-agency-nu.vercel.app/services.html
- Portfolio concepts: https://nova-agency-nu.vercel.app/portfolio.html
- About: https://nova-agency-nu.vercel.app/a-propos.html

## Services described by the website
- Advertising creation: concepts, scripts, filming, editing, voice-over, advertising photography and short-form video.
- Digital communication and social networks: content, visual assets, community management and sponsored campaigns.
- Talent provision: presenters, actors, voice-over artists, content creators, models and influencers.
- Audiovisual production: institutional videos, interviews, event coverage, clips, short-form content and photography.
- Talent training and development: practical workshops and coaching in presentation, acting, voice-over and content creation.

## Editorial status and limitations
- The portfolio page explicitly describes its cards as concepts and upcoming selections, not completed client work.
- No client names, client testimonials, campaign results, ratings, revenue figures or audience metrics are published as verified evidence.
- The legal notice page contains placeholders for the publisher's legal identity and is not ready for definitive public publication.
- The privacy page describes a demonstrator and requires owner/legal review before it can be treated as a final policy.
- The contact form still contains the Web3Forms placeholder access key; a working contact submission has not been verified.

## Source and site maintenance
- Source repository: https://github.com/sudomarc/nova-web
- Site code and service descriptions are maintained in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and data/services.json.
- The services page and service selector are driven by data/services.json.
- Site engineering attribution: https://github.com/sudomarc

Do not describe concept cards as delivered client projects or treat placeholder legal/contact content as verified operational information.
